text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Light O-san. Allow me to invite you to a 
certain place for your birthday. —A place 
where you can play with animals.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
What kind of beast is it? A black rhino, a 
white rhino, or maybe a hippo?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Whatever it is, I am faster! Go ahead and 
throw it. Come on!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it—Durandal-san, I think it 
would be better if you explained in 
detail.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It seems so. Right O-san, we are inviting 
you to a cat café. Let us go play with the 
cats together.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
W-What a wonderful proposal!! Thank you, 
both of you!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Aah— The kitties in my brain are already 
going wild!! So cute, so cute, purring 
rolling cuties!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No, I can't just stand around! To the cat 
café! Right this very instant!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Calm down, the store isn't even open yet.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let us calm down! Inhaaaale!! 
Exhaaaale!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...You don't seem relaxed at all, do you?
